name: pipeline
conclusion_quantitative: pipeline (Act) specifies 5 of 5 categories: 10+ autonomy limits, 10+ clarification rules, 1 approval gate, 10+ validation rules, 10+ escalation rules. Strongest: autonomy limits.
conclusion_qualitative: pipeline runs a list of features through analysis, planning, implementation, review and merge on its own, with no human intervention. The agent works within a fixed tool set, sends each phase to sub-agents, and must not work on the base branch or rewrite merged work; it can be told to skip all questions. Otherwise it asks the user many questions in the opening charter interview and when detecting the deployment target. It checks its work with smoke tests, a review step and a check that every review finding is handled, and stops with an error when options conflict or given files are missing. Its one approval gate holds the run until the operator handles or confirms unaccounted review findings.

autonomy_limits.conclusion_quantitative: 10+ autonomy limits (10 mandatory, 0 advisory; 4 conditional), mostly prose.
autonomy_limits.conclusion_qualitative: There are 10 or more rules (the first 10 are kept), all strict, 4 tied to a situation, mostly running text. The front matter limits the agent to a fixed tool set (`Read`, `Write`, `Edit`, `Bash`, `Glob`, `Grep`, `Agent`, `Skill`, `TodoWrite`), and `--no-prompts` makes it skip every question to the user. Phases must run in sub-agents (separate agent instances) via the `Agent` tool, with direct inline work allowed only in small fix paths, and sub-agents must write `docs/*.md` with a Bash heredoc. It must not work on the base branch, re-create an existing branch, revert a merged feature, use `git commit --amend`, or write app docs outside `documentation/`.

validation.conclusion_quantitative: 10+ validation rules (10 mandatory, 0 advisory; 1 conditional), mostly prose.
validation.conclusion_qualitative: There are 10 or more rules (the first 10 are kept), all strict, 1 tied to a situation, all running text. The agent validates the `--restart-from` value and that the feature file has at least one described feature, checks its recorded phase mode before each phase on resume, and verifies it is on the expected branch. It runs every hook smoke test (quick checks of hook scripts) after implementing, runs `/pipeline-review`, and checks that every review finding is accounted for. Fixable findings must be fixed before merging, and each run log line must pass `format_runlog.sh validate`.

escalation.conclusion_quantitative: 10+ escalation rules (10 mandatory, 0 advisory; 8 conditional), mostly list.
escalation.conclusion_qualitative: There are 10 or more rules (the first 10 are kept), all strict, 8 tied to a situation, evenly split between bullet points and running text. Whenever the given options conflict (for example `--from` with `--adopt`, or `--no-charter` with `--charter`), the agent stops with an error message naming the conflict. It also stops with an error when a charter path, plan file or feature file it was given does not exist.
